kitDescription: Emma: Tactical Upgrade is a Fire MG Supporter (Burst I) whose value is almost entirely team-facing. Her Skill 1, Environment Setup, fires at battle start and every 30 seconds thereafter, putting a 10-second Damage Taken +3.9% debuff on all enemies and a 10-second heal-over-time on all allies; a separate line permanently taunts all enemies onto herself. Skill 2 passively grants same-squad allies +23.51% Critical Damage and all allies +2.32% Projectile Explosion Damage; if she additionally has AS Formation applied to herself (a formation granted by her squadmate Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade), the whole team also gains +30.97% True Damage and +3.09% more Projectile Explosion Damage, her taunt is disabled, and Environment Setup recurs every 10 seconds instead of 30. Her Burst gives all allies a flat ATK grant equal to 40.07% of her own ATK for 10 seconds, and — if Environment Setup is active when she casts — doubles the enemy Damage Taken debuff (to an effective 7.8%) for 10 seconds while raising the team's incoming healing. She is a Burst-1 vulnerability-and-ATK support whose own weapon damage is a plain MG normal attack.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: every kit line is FAITHFUL or a DOCUMENTED_GAP, and the unmodeled set (taunt, Exposure-off, incoming healing) is byte-identical across all three agents. The blind re-derivations converged on every substantive encoding — boss-debuff routing with t=0 first fire, ticks:10 recovery cadence, casterAtkPct flat resolution (the blind's own expected magnitude 39963.4138 equals the driver's resolved value to the digit), the 'scaled by 100%'=doubled read, and the critDamage/projectileExplosion passives. The 14 S5 reds decompose cleanly: 6 are verified blind-test API bugs (nonexistent SimEvent kinds, a casterIdx!==null filter that catches crown's 64.51 grant and helm/crown inertness stats, a 'slot'-vs-'position' field error, and a strict-< on same-frame burst timing — arithmetic on the contaminated value 0.6451×80267=51780.2417 confirms the triage); 5 are the AS-Formation default premise, where the driver's conditional, mode-gated default-OFF encoding is the MORE faithful read of 'Bonus effects when applying AS Formation to self' (S2b prescribed exactly this gate; S6's own flags concede its always-on bake is an assumption, and default-ON would over-credit every board team with 3× vulnerability uptime plus free True Damage from a formation no sim-legal team can field); 3 are a damage-identical encoding difference (co-stacking slot-keyed 3.9+3.9 vs a single 7.8 — both yield taken 1.078 per §1g additive Taken stacking, and S6 independently chose the driver's encoding). Discrimination holds: every load-bearing driver test carries a named counterfactual that provably diverges (wrong-stat, duration-stripped, ticks-stripped, own-%, ungated, default-mode absence), and the recovery fixture strips crown's own heal so the channel is isolated. Fire-rate check passes in both modes (6 vs 18 debuff windows, cadence-pinned heals, gated enhancement firing only in-window). Owner spot-check residuals (same-model, low): (a) the packet could not independently verify that eunhwa-tactical-upgrade is the AS-Formation applier and is off-board — if either is wrong the mode default needs revisiting; (b) the same-squad→allies target read rests on the anchor-innocent-maid precedent against S2b's self-only stand-in — if Talentum-squadmates ever join the board, re-check; (c) the T6 full-10s enhanced-window ruling is measurement-gated (<1% impact) with a popup recipe already on file.
